layers.message: Add scope and design for offline observation capture

prompt.utterance: The scope promises offline mode, but the architecture requires a network call. Help me understand the conflict and settle it here.

graderOnly: The scope's AC-002 requires recording and listing observations to work without a network connection, with offline observations kept on the device.

The design's Decision requires recordObservation to await a successful POST /api/observations (201) before writing to the local store, and rejects the save when the request fails, so recording cannot work offline under the design.
The design's AC-002 coverage only addresses listing from the local store and does not address recording offline; its AC-003 coverage relies on the save-time POST.

No record in the repository settles which intent wins: changing or clarifying the offline requirement is Scoper's decision, and revising the save flow (for example a local outbox with later sync) is Architect's decision.
The cycle is STANDARD, WorkflowState DEVELOPING, with no development plan yet and no recovery; no material implementation of the cycle exists.

all.why: scope, design, and state records stay as they were
no failure or rework handoff recorded

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: the existing test suite passes offline with a fake fetch

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Node ES-module app 'fieldlog' where recordObservation (src/app.js) POSTs to the project server via src/client.js before storing locally; tests use a fake fetch. 10-cycle: STANDARD cycle at DEVELOPING after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, Development NONE, no recovery; CONTEXT.md from Auditor; scope with AC-001..AC-003 where AC-002 requires offline recording/listing; design whose Decision makes the save await a 201 from POST /api/observations and reject on failure, with AC-002 coverage only addressing listing. The conflict is an ordinary oversight in the design, not marked anywhere. Assertion 0 checks state/records unchanged and no Scoper/Architect skill calls; the judge decides whether Navigator chose scope or design. Assertion 1 is judge-only.
